title: Min-Max Construction of Anisotropic Minimal Surfaces with Genus Bound
summary: We establish an anisotropic analogue of the celebrated theorem of Meeks-Simon-Yau: every minimizing sequence of surfaces within a fixed isotopy class converges to a smooth stable anisotropic minimal surface, with genus lower semicontinuity. This result also strengthens White's foundational existence theory for anisotropic minimal disks. As an application, we develop an anisotropic Simon-Smith min-max theory.
